page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn7i-c48g1.12xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server powered by 48 dedicated physical cores of an Intel Xeon 8369B processor running at 2.9 GHz. It features 310.0 GB of system memory, providing 6.46 GB per core. Acceleration is delivered via a single NVIDIA A10 GPU from the Ampere architecture, equipped with 24 GB of VRAM. The instance does not include local storage, meaning external storage solutions must be attached. Network performance is anchored by a 16 Gbps baseline bandwidth.

Benchmark results indicate strong capabilities in specific parallel processing and cryptographic tasks. The server achieved a strong rating in multi-threaded bzip3 decompression at 230.87 GB/sec and in the PassMark CPU encryption test at 42,228.64. Geekbench image processing also scored in the top 25% tier with 15,395.0. Notably, the hardware excels in small to medium large language model inference. For a 135M model, prompt processing reached 9,711.08 tokens/sec and text generation reached 456.51 tokens/sec, both placing in the top 10% tier. Similarly, for a 7B model, prompt processing achieved 2,509.43 tokens/sec and text generation reached 90.44 tokens/sec, also in the top 10% tier.

The lack of local storage requires reliance on network-attached storage, which may introduce latency tradeoffs depending on the storage tier selected. However, the combination of 48 dedicated Intel Xeon cores, 310.0 GB of RAM, and an NVIDIA A10 GPU makes this instance efficient for GPU-accelerated workloads such as medium-scale model inference, image processing, and cryptographic operations.
